decisions.reason: Core piqué upholstery fabric with its own page and close alignment to the established range keeps drop risk very low.
Flame-retardant jacquard curtain fabric has contract-market functionality and own-page support, so it remains a strong keeper.
Premium double-face wool blend still warrants market testing even though it is only mentioned on the website.
Semi-transparent wool bouclé leno is specialized but still fits the collection and sustainability direction, so it deserves more time.
Recently launched braided-structure fabric has its own page and should be given time to establish market presence.
